title: Songs of Yggdrasil: Shamanic Chants from the Northern Mysteries
description:
Experience the Power and Beauty of the Norse Tradition
Freya Aswynn, Priestess of Odin and Rune Mistress, presents the history of runes in what can only be called a magical performance. Both powerful and moving, these chants are living, potent spells. Included on this extraordinary 40-minute CD is a unique adaptation of the Havamal, the ancient myth of the runes and how they were discovered by Odin. Freya also performs an actual invocation of the gods, a circle casting, and more. This is perhaps the only existing recording of a rune practitioner demonstrating the art of galdr, the magical technique of vibrating runes. With Freya's remarkable vocal range, you can actually feel the runic power flow.

Born in Holland, Freya Aswynn was aware of her natural psychic abilities as early as four years old, often able to perceive what would occur before it did. At the age of 19, with no real formal education except for the abilities to read and to write, Aswynn decided to develop her gift even further. She initially joined a spiritualist group, and later went on to study such subjects as Rosicrucianism, Astrology, Cabala, Thelema, and was eventually initiated into Wicca in 1980.

After awhile, Aswynn began to question why the only gods mentioned were Graeco-Roman or Celtic in descent because they had no relationship to her own Dutch heritage. She then came to discover that there in fact were Nordic gods, and it was after a difficult personal experience that she became devoted to the Norse god, Wodan. It was Wodan's help that influenced Aswynn to begin her research on the occult and the Northern traditions. Runes had had an important impact on her life, so she began by studying them and their connection to Northern Europe and also began her first book, Leaves of Yggdrasil. She is also the author of Principles of the Runes, Northern Mysteries & Magick: Runes, Gods & Feminine Powers, and an audio CD, Songs of Yggdrasil: Shamanic Chants from the Northern Mysteries.

title: Not Too Scary Vocabulary: For the SAT & Other Standardized Tests With 36 Page Booklet
description: Gr 10 Up-Vocabulary study and fun may be an oxymoron to most students, but Renee Mazer presents an ebullient and gregarious approach to the topic. She works her way through more than 500 words from abash to zealous, introducing each word, spelling it, defining it, and putting it into a sentence. She then gives a mnemonic such as a silly song, poem, or story that relates to teen interests and will help listeners learn the new word. Mazer sounds exactly like a teenager herself. She giggles at her "weirdness," occasionally questions her knowledge, and uses plenty of slang. The audio quality and general tone of these tapes is not highly professional. Nevertheless, they are designed for young people trying to learn vocabulary in preparation for standardized tests. This is usually a boring, tedious task, and adolescents will surely enjoy Mazer's undictionary-like definitions and risque stories. For example, she describes a sycophant as one who "sucks up" or is a "butt-kisser," and her suggestion for how to remember the word "wanton" includes a story about a couple eating in a Chinese restaurant and the young man telling his date that he likes "her wontons." Mazer admits that her singing is poor and her ideas "corny." Though teens will most likely agree, they will certainly find these tapes a more palatable and less tiresome way of learning vocabulary than wading through SAT prep books. The accompanying booklet listing all of the words and their definitions has some humorous illustrations and includes a "romance" quiz that reviews many of the words.-Marilyn Higgins, Metuchen High School, NJ Copyright 2003 Reed Business Information.

title: Mozart: Die Entfuhrung aus dem Serail / Solti, Venna State Opera Chorus, Vienna PO
description: Used - very good condition

The plot is silly: two European sopranos (Konstanze and her maid Blonde) have been kidnapped by pirates and sold to a Middle-Eastern potentate, Pasha Selim, who puts them in his harem and then waits docilely for Konstanze to fall in love with him. A tenor (Pedrillo) has also been enslaved and put to work as a handyman. Belmonte, Konstanze's lover, comes on the scene, determined to rescue the captives; he and Pedrillo give the overseer Osmin (bass) drugged wine, begin to escape, and are captured and scheduled for execution when the Pasha decides to let them go. Two hours of ado about nothing, except that it gave Mozart the occasion to write some of the finest music of his early maturity. Georg Solti and his all-star musicians give a dazzling performances. --Joe McLellan

title: Pet Music tm
description: Keep your pet calm and comforted while you're away. These soothing CDs--a blend of New Age and classical music and ambient nature sounds--were created especially to help reduce the daily stress and separation anxiety often experienced by dogs, cats, birds, and other pets. Recommended by the ASPCA; sales help support pet-related charities. Over 3 hours of music on 3 CDs.

In a time when television commercials regularly promote pharmaceutical options for our depressed canine friends, a holistic option is a boon to companion animals everywhere. Heartily endorsed by the ASPCA, whose animal welfare programs benefit from a portion of the sales, Pet Music is a remarkable value, a three-disc set of soothing synthesized sounds with frequencies specially formulated to reduce the separation anxiety experienced by our four-legged roommates. The "Natural Rhythms" disc features the richness of strings and tinkling keys, "Peaceful Playground" brings together acoustic guitar stylings and bird sounds, and "Sunday in the Park" captures the gentle rhythmic patterns of easy outdoor afternoons. In the company of Pet Music, Rover and Felix are sure to experience enhanced well-being and relaxation in an increasingly stressful environment, and the new living-room suite is likely to profit from improved household behavior, as well. --Paige La Grone

description: Toddlers and preschoolers can perform their own version of the "Crocodile Rock" with this combination xylophone, piano, and pull-toy. This multitalented crocodile holds a mallet in its mouth for easy xylophone tapping. Or children can press the colorful keys on the crocodile's back and finger their own melodies. Pull the crocodile along by an attached string and it bobs up and down while jingling a sweet bell song. There are six notes for tapping or fingering--just enough for simple, recognizable melodies, such as "Baa, Baa Black Sheep" and "Mary Had a Little Lamb." This is an ideal starter instrument for ages 1.5 to 4 years. Approximately 14 inches long and 5.5 inches wide. --Gail Hudson

title: Raised On Songs And Stories
description: This is the first solo album for Ian Millar. Ian is the son of Joe Millar, a founder of the world famous Irish Rovers, and cousin of Will Millar, the former leader of the Irish Rovers. Born into a family known for its proud tradition of Celtic music, he was Raised On Songs And Stories. This album reflects that heritage and its impact on Ian's career. The wide-ranging tunes include traditional and contemporary Irish melodies, original compositions, and cross-over songs which show Ian's evolution and the broadening of his musical horizons.

Ian Millar hails from Ballymena, County Antrim, Northern Ireland. Ian inherited his rich vocal tones and musical ability from the best of both sides of his family. He was an official camp-follower of the Irish Rovers, following in his father Joe Millar's footsteps, taking to the stage and the road at an early age. When cousin Will Millar left the Rovers, Ian joined Will on the road as an integral member of Will's band, Some Mad Irishmen. Since then, Ian has toured the United States and Canada several times. He has also toured Australia and New Zealand four times, twice as a featured soloist with the stage production of "Ireland" in 1998 and 1999. Upon his return from "downunder" at the end of summer he will be touring the Midwestern United States. His many talents are on display in his first album, "Raised On Songs And Stories," as a vocalist, musician, songwriter, composer, arranger, and producer. All of which are done gracefully and with a unique flair. A legacy of Celtic music has blossomed into an array of musical styles for Ian: traditional to contemporary Irish fare, folk and soft rock to country and western, classical standards, and rhythm and blues. Whether it's a rollicking pub song or a heart song, evokes emotion for his audience because music is his life; it's in his soul. He's turned his enate passion for the stage and the road into a recognized and seasoned artistry that perfectly compliments his love for tall sailing ships and the sea, of being fancy free.

title: Three AM
description: Acoustic bass, piano, acoustic guitar, percussion, drums, Rhodes, D.J., cello, trumpet and vocals combine to form the Jazz and Acid Jazz inspired original music of Three AM. Vocalist/Lyricist Gretchen Lieberum lists such diverse artists as Joni Mitchell, Nina Simone, Sting, Spearhead, and Cassandra Wilson as influences.

While a Senior at Berkeley High School, Gretchen Lieberum entered the Reno International Jazz Festival and Competition, and won first place in the Jazz Vocal Solo Category. She began writing songs while singing for a funk band she started in college with bassist Mike Cruz called Supersauce, playing at venues such as the Filmore in San Francisco and The Catalyst in Santa Cruz. Several years later, she started jamming and writing songs with piano man Jacob Aginsky, eventually creating the music that became Gretchen's debut solo CD, Three AM.

Three AM, completed in March of 1999, was produced by Greg Poree, who has worked as a musician and as a producer with artists such as Cassandra Wilson, Sting, Vinx, and Stevie Wonder. Gretchen recently made her first music video for the single "These Things", directed by Jacob Estes and Danny Passman.

title: Dead Reckoning
description: Dead Reckoning is a diverse batch of songs, ranging from Mountain-friendly radio pop - to trip hop - to melancholy, jazz-tinged ballads. This intelligent, moody collection falls smack in the middle of Sarah McLachlin, Fiona Apple, and Portishead.

While Marit Peters's intensely personal songs will appeal to fans of Tori Amos and Fiona Apple, there is a poetic quality to Peters's lyrics that sets her apart as a songwriter's songwriter, much in the tradition of Paul Simon circa Bridge over Troubled Water. On the gently swaying ballad "Theater," Peters relates to the wintry fate of the cherry tree with a soulful vocal performance that at its emotional zenith recalls Aretha Franklin. On the heavy-hearted "Let the Happiness In," Peters pays homage to a lost friend or relative--as does much of Dead Reckoning--and with a poet's deft hand discovers hope in the despairingly cold and stark world that surrounds her. Like Amos, Peters is an accomplished pianist who summons a tonal foundation that perfectly supports the emotional core of the songs. To round out the album, she surrounds herself with a topnotch band that follows every step she takes with commendable restraint and takes care to put the songs before their own highly accomplished musicianship. The result is a mature debut by an artist who is in control of her craft and ready to take it to a wider audience. --Michael Wells

title: Graceful Passages
description:
Graceful Passages: A Companion for Living and Dying, is a double CD Gift-book containing music with spoken messages from skilled guides who have faced pain, loss, illness, or near-death while birthing a compassionate wisdom in the process. Included are the voices of Elisabeth Kubler-Ross, Ram Dass, Thich Nhat Hanh, Arun and Sunanda Gandhi and others. Catholic, Protestant and Jewish clergy are represented as well as Native American, Confucian and Buddhist perspectives, creating a truly multi-faith resource. Woven with a customized musical score of great beauty, it creates a compelling invitation for the listener to consider the eternal questions of life.

What Graceful Passages is for:

Provides relaxation, fresh insight and a renewal of faith for anyone exploring issues of life and death.

Assists dying persons, their families and caregivers to shift from denial to acceptance

Addresses such themes as letting go, closure, expressing love, forgiveness, appreciation of life, and continuity of spirit from interfaith viewpoints.

Models compassionate communication, helping people be present with themselves and their loved ones during challenging times.

Music by Emmy award-winning composer Gary Remal Malkin enhances the delivery of the messages; the instrumental version provides an evocative meditation.

Both CDs are included in this elegant hardbound gift package. The 56-page book features transcriptions of all spoken words, as well as writings by bestselling author Sam Keen; nationally known palliative care physician Dr. Ira Byock; and The Grace in Dying author, Kathleen Dowling Singh, Ph.D. Enhanced by lovely still-life photography and an understated elegance, Graceful Passages makes an ideal gift for someone experiencing loss or challenging times. It is also excellent as a resource for caregivers and anyone in the healthcare, psychotherapeutic, healing arts, or pastoral counseling fields

title: All Things Must Pass
description: This was a surprise!  Back in 1970 with the break-up of The Beatles, all focus was naturally on the main songwriters/singers, John Lennon and Paul McCartney, to see what they would do next.  However, it was George that hit the ground running with All Things Must Pass.  That it turned out to be the very first triple album ever released was even more surprising to many, given how few tracks he had ever written for The Beatles.  In reality of course, he had been writing seriously for years and had worked on some songs with Dylan and The Band in '68.    By the time he was to record the songs he had been amassing over these years, he was able to round up a  stellar band inclduing Ringo Starr, Eric Clapton, members of Badfinger, Billy Preston, Bobby Whitlock, Gary Brooker (ex-Procul Harem) and Gary Wright as well as members of Delaney and Bonnies band with whom he had toured in 1969.  The sessions were produced by Phil Spector, then renowned as the genius inventor of the "Wall of Sound".  On release it spent 7 weeks at No.1 in the USA and 8 weeks in the UK (although due to a postal strike at the time this was not officially recognised until 2006!!) and is one of the most successful of any solo Beatles albums.  George himself remastered the album in 2000, living long enough to see it released to great critical acclaim and commercial success in 2001.  Featuring bonus tracks, reworked (and colourful) artwork etc the decision was taken at the time to delete the original version and this has not been in print since then.  Now, almost 40 years to the day since its' release, Olivia Harrison is releasing the ORIGINAL ALBUM in the ORIGINAL ARTWORK for a limited edition vinyl release.    The perfect celebration of a great artist and a truly great, groundbreaking album, this follows the massive chart success of 2009's "Let It Roll", which entered the UK chart at 3 in May of that year as well as the huge success of the seminal 2009 remasters of The Beatles studio albums.

title: Twilight
description:
Woodland's new album Twilight is a musical exploration of the realm of Faerie. On this album Woodland has taken their underground Celtic-inspired trance-rock to new levels, with high-quality ethereal production and a collection of new and old tunes which inspire visions of Faerie.

Fans of Woodland's EP editions- Heritage and Into The Twilight - will be delighted to hear new recordings of tunes like 'I Remember' and 'Midnight Ring', and the addition of magical new songs such as 'Mermaid' and 'Silver Crow'. In addition the album features digitally-remastered remixes of favorites from Into The Twilight, such as 'The Dragon', 'The Grove' and 'Morgana Moon'.

Twilight also has Enhanced CD extras which include Masques, a video of never before seen film, art and photography by Brian Froud set to an original score by Woodland. In addition, the ECD portion also includes a live video of Woodland in Los Angeles at the Faerieworlds Festival, and an interview with Woodland founders Kelly and Emilio Miller-Lopez. Twilight also features a sixteen page booklet of Woodland poetry and Brian Froud artwork.
...Woodland weaves a musical soundscape for the Faery traveler. I recommend their work to those enchanted with the Faerie Realm..." -- Brian Froud- 2002

title: Suenos Infinitos
description: Suenos Infinitos is an extraordinary fusion of Flamenco, Jazz and Latin rhythms combined with solo acoustic performances. The music is filled with passion and romance! Inspired by the belief that we should all pursue our dreams and that we all have an infinite ability to bring them to realization! This unique and powerful music is guaranteed to soothe the soul of all that listen!

For more than twenty years Mark Romero has turned to his guitar for musical expression. While still enjoying a highly successful career outside of music, Romero has remained dedicated to composing and performing.

As a college music major, Mark studied jazz, classical, and Flamenco guitar, eventually blending all three styles into his own unique compositions. Much to his delight, his distinct acoustical fusion found an immediate and devoted audience.

In response to his newfound fans, Mark recorded his first CD entitled To Shine the Light, a collection of passionate Spanish acoustical solo performances.

And now his second CD entitled Suenos Infinitos (Infinite Dreams) has just been released. An extraordinary fusion of Flamenco, Jazz and Latin rhythms combined with solo acoustic performances, Romero once again proves his musical mastery. Even more to his credit, this latest release has both strengthened his original audience and found new converts.

Mark Romeros music isnt the only thing that sets him apart from the rest. As creator and founder of Options, a company that provides alternative paths to excellence and unimaginable achievement through the avenues of business, golf, and music, Mark has developed yet another kind of fusion. By blending his original music compositions with his motivational speaking, Mark Romero is changing the way people learn. Audiences of all ages and cultures experience a stirring musical performance that encourages, inspires and entertains while learning Romeros Options for Excellence.

His musical performances filled with passion and romance, Mark Romero is dedicated to entertaining, motivating, and touching the souls of all who listen.

title: Kidz Bop 5
description: The latest installment of the best selling Kidz Bop series is here with 30 all new tracks!     Disc 1  Crazy In Love Hey Ya Are You Happy Now? Invisible It's My Life Here Without You Girls & Boys So Yesterday Calling All Angels Bigger Than My Body  Forever And For Always Someday Have A Little Faith In Me Bright Lights Cinderella      Disc 2  There's Gotta Be (More To Life) Senorita Why Don't You & I Never Leave You (Uh Oooh, Uh Oooh) Perfect Headstrong  Me Against The Music Unwell Breathe Take Me Away Low Rain On Me Trouble  So Far Away Dig It

Tempting as it is to dismiss the Kidz Bop craze as a temporary triumph of bad taste, the release of the fifth disc in the series signals that the time has come to start listening. Kidz Bop 5 cinches together a music scene fragmented beyond recognition for easy consumption. If you're not familiar with the rocker Headstrong it's probably because you're tuned in to a format friendlier to the pure-pop Crazy in Love; Kidz Bop snaps the barrier between the two and introduces kids and out-of-the-loop parents to both. The benefit of the all-kid chorus, other than confirming for 5- to 10-year-olds that they are where they ought to be, remains elusive, but it's not unbearable. Bottom line: If you've got to start bopping sometime, now's as good a time as any. --Tammy La Gorce

title: Pet Music tm
description: Keep your pet calm and comforted while you're away. These soothing CDs--a blend of New Age and classical music and ambient nature sounds--were created especially to help reduce the daily stress and separation anxiety often experienced by dogs, cats, birds, and other pets. Recommended by the ASPCA; sales help support pet-related charities. Over 3 hours of music on 3 CDs.

In a time when television commercials regularly promote pharmaceutical options for our depressed canine friends, a holistic option is a boon to companion animals everywhere. Heartily endorsed by the ASPCA, whose animal welfare programs benefit from a portion of the sales, Pet Music is a remarkable value, a three-disc set of soothing synthesized sounds with frequencies specially formulated to reduce the separation anxiety experienced by our four-legged roommates. The "Natural Rhythms" disc features the richness of strings and tinkling keys, "Peaceful Playground" brings together acoustic guitar stylings and bird sounds, and "Sunday in the Park" captures the gentle rhythmic patterns of easy outdoor afternoons. In the company of Pet Music, Rover and Felix are sure to experience enhanced well-being and relaxation in an increasingly stressful environment, and the new living-room suite is likely to profit from improved household behavior, as well. --Paige La Grone

title: You Walked Into My Life / Why Did I Lose You
description: Toddlers and preschoolers can perform their own version of the "Crocodile Rock" with this combination xylophone, piano, and pull-toy. This multitalented crocodile holds a mallet in its mouth for easy xylophone tapping. Or children can press the colorful keys on the crocodile's back and finger their own melodies. Pull the crocodile along by an attached string and it bobs up and down while jingling a sweet bell song. There are six notes for tapping or fingering--just enough for simple, recognizable melodies, such as "Baa, Baa Black Sheep" and "Mary Had a Little Lamb." This is an ideal starter instrument for ages 1.5 to 4 years. Approximately 14 inches long and 5.5 inches wide. --Gail Hudson

title: Raised On Songs And Stories
description: This is the first solo album for Ian Millar. Ian is the son of Joe Millar, a founder of the world famous Irish Rovers, and cousin of Will Millar, the former leader of the Irish Rovers. Born into a family known for its proud tradition of Celtic music, he was Raised On Songs And Stories. This album reflects that heritage and its impact on Ian's career. The wide-ranging tunes include traditional and contemporary Irish melodies, original compositions, and cross-over songs which show Ian's evolution and the broadening of his musical horizons.

Ian Millar hails from Ballymena, County Antrim, Northern Ireland. Ian inherited his rich vocal tones and musical ability from the best of both sides of his family. He was an official camp-follower of the Irish Rovers, following in his father Joe Millar's footsteps, taking to the stage and the road at an early age. When cousin Will Millar left the Rovers, Ian joined Will on the road as an integral member of Will's band, Some Mad Irishmen. Since then, Ian has toured the United States and Canada several times. He has also toured Australia and New Zealand four times, twice as a featured soloist with the stage production of "Ireland" in 1998 and 1999. Upon his return from "downunder" at the end of summer he will be touring the Midwestern United States. His many talents are on display in his first album, "Raised On Songs And Stories," as a vocalist, musician, songwriter, composer, arranger, and producer. All of which are done gracefully and with a unique flair. A legacy of Celtic music has blossomed into an array of musical styles for Ian: traditional to contemporary Irish fare, folk and soft rock to country and western, classical standards, and rhythm and blues. Whether it's a rollicking pub song or a heart song, evokes emotion for his audience because music is his life; it's in his soul. He's turned his enate passion for the stage and the road into a recognized and seasoned artistry that perfectly compliments his love for tall sailing ships and the sea, of being fancy free.

title: Three AM
description: Acoustic bass, piano, acoustic guitar, percussion, drums, Rhodes, D.J., cello, trumpet and vocals combine to form the Jazz and Acid Jazz inspired original music of Three AM. Vocalist/Lyricist Gretchen Lieberum lists such diverse artists as Joni Mitchell, Nina Simone, Sting, Spearhead, and Cassandra Wilson as influences.

While a Senior at Berkeley High School, Gretchen Lieberum entered the Reno International Jazz Festival and Competition, and won first place in the Jazz Vocal Solo Category. She began writing songs while singing for a funk band she started in college with bassist Mike Cruz called Supersauce, playing at venues such as the Filmore in San Francisco and The Catalyst in Santa Cruz. Several years later, she started jamming and writing songs with piano man Jacob Aginsky, eventually creating the music that became Gretchen's debut solo CD, Three AM.

Three AM, completed in March of 1999, was produced by Greg Poree, who has worked as a musician and as a producer with artists such as Cassandra Wilson, Sting, Vinx, and Stevie Wonder. Gretchen recently made her first music video for the single "These Things", directed by Jacob Estes and Danny Passman.

title: Dead Reckoning
description: Dead Reckoning is a diverse batch of songs, ranging from Mountain-friendly radio pop - to trip hop - to melancholy, jazz-tinged ballads. This intelligent, moody collection falls smack in the middle of Sarah McLachlin, Fiona Apple, and Portishead.

While Marit Peters's intensely personal songs will appeal to fans of Tori Amos and Fiona Apple, there is a poetic quality to Peters's lyrics that sets her apart as a songwriter's songwriter, much in the tradition of Paul Simon circa Bridge over Troubled Water. On the gently swaying ballad "Theater," Peters relates to the wintry fate of the cherry tree with a soulful vocal performance that at its emotional zenith recalls Aretha Franklin. On the heavy-hearted "Let the Happiness In," Peters pays homage to a lost friend or relative--as does much of Dead Reckoning--and with a poet's deft hand discovers hope in the despairingly cold and stark world that surrounds her. Like Amos, Peters is an accomplished pianist who summons a tonal foundation that perfectly supports the emotional core of the songs. To round out the album, she surrounds herself with a topnotch band that follows every step she takes with commendable restraint and takes care to put the songs before their own highly accomplished musicianship. The result is a mature debut by an artist who is in control of her craft and ready to take it to a wider audience. --Michael Wells

title: The Experience: Praise-Intimacy-Worship-Celebration
description:
Serving up an exciting blend of music they have coined urban praise & worship, a sound combining all of lifes experiences, both spiritual and secular, this group of young men is taking cues from fellow Christian acts who have broken

through to mainstream markets. Gideons sound is poised to, as they say, Take the Cross Over! Recorded live before a packed audience at Washington, DCs renowned Duke Ellington School of the Performing Arts,

The Experience: Praise-Intimacy-Worship-Celebration is a breakthrough recording that promises to touch listeners worldwide. Tracks include offerings of gospel, contemporary-Christian, urban, pop, R&B, old-school funk and even rock. With a live-set performance style reminiscent of the big bands of yesteryear, Gideon has the distinction of being one of the few full-fledged bands in gospel music. That flavor burst forth on this self-produced debut project featuring everything from rousing call and response numbers to infectious dance tracks to tear-jerking ballads. Executive Producers: Cornelius Berkeley, Edward Henderson, Warren Jones, Micheal Richardson, B. Al Izlar Producers: Gideon Band

I'm extremely impressed. I've rarely seen a group and project cover so many musical genres with such success and anointing. -- Joseph Birney - Verity Records

I'm so proud of the boys. They've come such a long way. This CD is "bout it, bout it!!!!!" -- Marsha Sumner - 1580 AM Wash., DC On-Air Personality

These brothers are about to blow-up! Catch them now before they rise to the top!! -- Larnell Satchell - WRTC FM, Hartford, CT.

title: <span id="parentalAdvisory" class="a-size-medium a-color-secondary a-text-normal"
description: These indigenous ayahuasca songs are recorded live in the Peruvian Amazon Jungle. The ayahuasquero who is conducting a ceremony, sings these traditional and sacred songs with the intent for creating an environment of healing and protection for the participants in the ceremony. Ayahuasca, a visionary and healing plant medicine, has been used by Amazonian shamans for millennia. This CD takes us on a magical journey into the spirit of Peruvian Ayahuasca Shamanism. One hour and ten minutes of continuous singing.

title: Graceful Passages
description:
Graceful Passages: A Companion for Living and Dying, is a double CD Gift-book containing music with spoken messages from skilled guides who have faced pain, loss, illness, or near-death while birthing a compassionate wisdom in the process. Included are the voices of Elisabeth Kubler-Ross, Ram Dass, Thich Nhat Hanh, Arun and Sunanda Gandhi and others. Catholic, Protestant and Jewish clergy are represented as well as Native American, Confucian and Buddhist perspectives, creating a truly multi-faith resource. Woven with a customized musical score of great beauty, it creates a compelling invitation for the listener to consider the eternal questions of life.

What Graceful Passages is for:

Provides relaxation, fresh insight and a renewal of faith for anyone exploring issues of life and death.

Assists dying persons, their families and caregivers to shift from denial to acceptance

Addresses such themes as letting go, closure, expressing love, forgiveness, appreciation of life, and continuity of spirit from interfaith viewpoints.

Models compassionate communication, helping people be present with themselves and their loved ones during challenging times.

Music by Emmy award-winning composer Gary Remal Malkin enhances the delivery of the messages; the instrumental version provides an evocative meditation.

Both CDs are included in this elegant hardbound gift package. The 56-page book features transcriptions of all spoken words, as well as writings by bestselling author Sam Keen; nationally known palliative care physician Dr. Ira Byock; and The Grace in Dying author, Kathleen Dowling Singh, Ph.D. Enhanced by lovely still-life photography and an understated elegance, Graceful Passages makes an ideal gift for someone experiencing loss or challenging times. It is also excellent as a resource for caregivers and anyone in the healthcare, psychotherapeutic, healing arts, or pastoral counseling fields

title: Shout To The Lord Kids
description: "Shout To The Lord Kids" is a totally new concept in children's worship music. In fact, it might better be called a worship project for all generations because it will stay on permanent loan to teens and parents alike. Worship leaders Steve Fee, Candi Pearson, Jeffery B. Scott and Jennifer Carrozza, along with some of the most talented musicians in the country, present today's most powerful worship songs in a uniquely innovative way. Featuring "Open The Eyes Of My Heart" "I Could Sing Of Your Love Forever," "So Good To Me" and many more. Shout To The Lord Kids will capture the heart of kids of any age and inspire them to worship the Lord Of All.

This album was recorded in conjuction with the North Point Community Church in Alpharetta, Georgia. There, you can find two of the most resounding kids' ministry programs in the country; KidStuf and Upstreet Kids. Using multimedia, actors, musicians and storytellers, their high-energy mesage is setting a new precedence for family worship.

title: Take The World
description:
"A polished band that is on target with their brand of modern rock...they are ready now for market exposure" -- Music Connection Magazine

"Like a beacon in the night sky they took the stage hostage and blew the crowd away with their performance." -- Live Magazine

"This lily can sing!" -- Rock City News

Lily's Siren is a Female fronted Modern Pop Band that has spent the last two years making waves on the local L.A. music scene. Their mix of compelling harmonies, crunchy guitar, and unforgetable hooks has a sound that's been said to be somewhere between Fleetwood Mac meets Nirvana. Lily's Siren is currently on tour in support of thier self-released CD "Take The World".

title: dancing in dreams
description: Originally a 1988 UK release on the Aura label as Fatal Embrace, this album was first made available in the US in 1992 on the Blue City imprint. Featuring several additional unreleased tracks, Dancing in Dreams is a collection of thirteen Barbarian Lovers songs, each unique unto itself, yet woven together by a sense of possession, abandonment, and longing, and punctuated by the pain of unrequited passion. Culled from the band's early 1984-88 period, the material compellingly captures the Barb's burgeoning songwriting skills, affording the listener the opportunity to see why this band became one of the best-kept secrets of the 1980s. US version includes duo-fold lyric booklet.

"Each time I hear it...I love it more. Search your record store for this...its more than worth it." -- Ken Nichols, Midnight Groove

"It's encouraging to hear a band release an album with just the right mixture of space and music." -- Kim Reed, On the Street, Australia

title: The Best of Robert & Robin Kochis
description: This album is a collection of some of the best songs recorded by Catholic recording artists Robert & Robin Kochis. These fifteen songs are taken from six of their eleven albums.

Having sung at hundreds of weddings over the years, the Kochis' began recording in 1990. Their second album, "How Great Thou Art" remains one of the top selling albums in Catholic Music. On "The Best of Robert & Robin Kochis", the beloved songs "On Eagle's Wings" and "Here I Am Lord" are found.

Using top studio musicians and beautiful choral accompaniments, Robert & Robin have worked with top arranger David Phillips to create albums of music that range in style from traditional Catholic music to contemporary Christian ballads.

title: The Sleep Fairy - Easy Sleep
description:
The Sleep Fairy's "Easy Sleep" is a nurturing guided relaxation that helps children of all ages drift effortlessly off to dreamland. The magical Sleep Fairy takes the listener through a magical bedtime routine featuring:

Progressive Relaxation
Remembering Positive Events of the Day
Creative Visualization
Good Dream Direction and
Positive Affirmations Regarding Good Behavior and Self-esteem

This is a spoken word recording designed to help children develop positive mental habits, increase self-esteem, and learn stress reducing techniques that can be used over and over. The results are amazing! Children who LOVE going to bed, no longer suffer from nightmares, and wake up cheerful in the morning! Parents are thrilled with the Sleep Fairy.
"Lisa Malkiewicz has created an absolute masterpiece. I wholeheartedly recommend The Sleep Fairy to anyone with children." -- Dr. Kristine Diener, Los Angeles, CA

title: All Things Must Pass
description: This was a surprise!  Back in 1970 with the break-up of The Beatles, all focus was naturally on the main songwriters/singers, John Lennon and Paul McCartney, to see what they would do next.  However, it was George that hit the ground running with All Things Must Pass.  That it turned out to be the very first triple album ever released was even more surprising to many, given how few tracks he had ever written for The Beatles.  In reality of course, he had been writing seriously for years and had worked on some songs with Dylan and The Band in '68.    By the time he was to record the songs he had been amassing over these years, he was able to round up a  stellar band inclduing Ringo Starr, Eric Clapton, members of Badfinger, Billy Preston, Bobby Whitlock, Gary Brooker (ex-Procul Harem) and Gary Wright as well as members of Delaney and Bonnies band with whom he had toured in 1969.  The sessions were produced by Phil Spector, then renowned as the genius inventor of the "Wall of Sound".  On release it spent 7 weeks at No.1 in the USA and 8 weeks in the UK (although due to a postal strike at the time this was not officially recognised until 2006!!) and is one of the most successful of any solo Beatles albums.  George himself remastered the album in 2000, living long enough to see it released to great critical acclaim and commercial success in 2001.  Featuring bonus tracks, reworked (and colourful) artwork etc the decision was taken at the time to delete the original version and this has not been in print since then.  Now, almost 40 years to the day since its' release, Olivia Harrison is releasing the ORIGINAL ALBUM in the ORIGINAL ARTWORK for a limited edition vinyl release.    The perfect celebration of a great artist and a truly great, groundbreaking album, this follows the massive chart success of 2009's "Let It Roll", which entered the UK chart at 3 in May of that year as well as the huge success of the seminal 2009 remasters of The Beatles studio albums.

title: Twilight
description:
Woodland's new album Twilight is a musical exploration of the realm of Faerie. On this album Woodland has taken their underground Celtic-inspired trance-rock to new levels, with high-quality ethereal production and a collection of new and old tunes which inspire visions of Faerie.

Fans of Woodland's EP editions- Heritage and Into The Twilight - will be delighted to hear new recordings of tunes like 'I Remember' and 'Midnight Ring', and the addition of magical new songs such as 'Mermaid' and 'Silver Crow'. In addition the album features digitally-remastered remixes of favorites from Into The Twilight, such as 'The Dragon', 'The Grove' and 'Morgana Moon'.

Twilight also has Enhanced CD extras which include Masques, a video of never before seen film, art and photography by Brian Froud set to an original score by Woodland. In addition, the ECD portion also includes a live video of Woodland in Los Angeles at the Faerieworlds Festival, and an interview with Woodland founders Kelly and Emilio Miller-Lopez. Twilight also features a sixteen page booklet of Woodland poetry and Brian Froud artwork.
...Woodland weaves a musical soundscape for the Faery traveler. I recommend their work to those enchanted with the Faerie Realm..." -- Brian Froud- 2002

title: Suenos Infinitos
description: Suenos Infinitos is an extraordinary fusion of Flamenco, Jazz and Latin rhythms combined with solo acoustic performances. The music is filled with passion and romance! Inspired by the belief that we should all pursue our dreams and that we all have an infinite ability to bring them to realization! This unique and powerful music is guaranteed to soothe the soul of all that listen!

For more than twenty years Mark Romero has turned to his guitar for musical expression. While still enjoying a highly successful career outside of music, Romero has remained dedicated to composing and performing.

As a college music major, Mark studied jazz, classical, and Flamenco guitar, eventually blending all three styles into his own unique compositions. Much to his delight, his distinct acoustical fusion found an immediate and devoted audience.

In response to his newfound fans, Mark recorded his first CD entitled To Shine the Light, a collection of passionate Spanish acoustical solo performances.

And now his second CD entitled Suenos Infinitos (Infinite Dreams) has just been released. An extraordinary fusion of Flamenco, Jazz and Latin rhythms combined with solo acoustic performances, Romero once again proves his musical mastery. Even more to his credit, this latest release has both strengthened his original audience and found new converts.

Mark Romeros music isnt the only thing that sets him apart from the rest. As creator and founder of Options, a company that provides alternative paths to excellence and unimaginable achievement through the avenues of business, golf, and music, Mark has developed yet another kind of fusion. By blending his original music compositions with his motivational speaking, Mark Romero is changing the way people learn. Audiences of all ages and cultures experience a stirring musical performance that encourages, inspires and entertains while learning Romeros Options for Excellence.

His musical performances filled with passion and romance, Mark Romero is dedicated to entertaining, motivating, and touching the souls of all who listen.

title: Mysteries
description: The long-awaited second release from Danielle Rose! The inspiration for these new compositions was Danielle's personal devotion to the rosary and Pope John Paul II's proclamation of the new set of Luminous Mysteries. Not merely a collection of devotional songs to Mary, these songs are expressions of how the Joyful, Luminous, Sorrowful, and Glorious Mysteries of the lives of Mary and Jesus intersect with our lives today. Most of the pieces are based on scriptural stories and written from the perspective of one of the key figures in the story. A beautiful, heart-felt collection by an immensely talented young woman.

A 2002 graduate of the University of Notre Dame, Danielle completed her degrees in both theology and music and was a member of the Notre Dame Folk Choir. Her music has moved and inspired audiences divergent in age and background.
